The best AI systems… are committees.
Welcome to Agent School — lesson nineteen.
Yesterday one agent planned a big task.
Today: what if each step had its own specialist?
In a multi-agent system, one manager agent splits the work and hands each piece to a specialist: a researcher, a writer, a reviewer.
Each specialist gets its own focused instructions and only the tools it needs.
The reviewer checks… and sends it back if it's wrong.
But more agents means more cost and more things to coordinate.
Use a team only when one agent truly struggles.
Remember: one manager, many specialists, and someone who checks the work.
